summary: Someone whose effort to change policy failed gets a chance at a larger job.
realLife: Hillary Rodham Clinton led the White House health reform effort whose bill stalled in 1994. Six years later New York voters elected her to the Senate.
inGame: needs: distinguish a later appointment or candidacy from success on the earlier proposal.

turns.what: The member accepts a place on the larger effort while declining to lead it.
turns.pulledBy: Their current office leaves time for hearings but not for running the effort.
turns.writesBack: The new appointment carries a narrower responsibility.

turns.what: When the state opens applications for its study panel, the former sponsor sends in the town’s defeated proposal.
turns.pulledBy: The panel’s charge includes the same question and accepts earlier local work.
turns.writesBack: The panel receives the proposal with its local vote history attached.
